dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000rft9](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000rft9) Magnitude 6.0 earthquake at 57.009 depth occurred on Oct 09 2025 119 km E of Ozernovskiy, Russia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 51.6264 longitude 158.2089. It impacted 85 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
